title: First login: forced password change, onboarding wizard reachable, change password in settings
goal: A new agency admin is made to choose their own password and is taken through company, regional and branding setup the first time they log in.
why: No forced first-login password change exists; settings.change-password is a stub (no backend endpoint); the onboarding wizard (desktop/src/app/(app)/onboarding/page.tsx) is linked from nowhere and its logo button shows "coming soon".
steps: Backend: POST /auth/change-password { currentPassword, newPassword } (authenticated; min 10 characters with at least one letter and one digit until R209 strengthens it; rejects reuse of the current password; bcrypt via utils/password.ts; clears must_change_password; revokes the user's other refresh tokens in SESSIONS; sends password_changed via sendTransactional). Login response and access token carry mustChangePassword (claim mcp); middleware/tenant.ts returns 403 PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED for any request with mcp=true except /auth/change-password, /auth/logout and /users/me.

Desktop: after login, if mustChangePassword -> /change-password (auth layout, EntityForm-style card with current/new/confirm, strength hint); on success refresh the token and continue. Then, if settings onboarding_completed is false and the user is admin -> /onboarding.

Onboarding page: wire the logo upload to the existing upload endpoint (POST /files/upload; replace the "coming soon" toast), save company, country, currency, timezone, tax system, numbering prefix through the existing settings endpoints, set onboarding_completed = true at the end, skip button sets it too. Add a "Finish setting up" item to the dashboard/sidebar for admins while onboarding_completed is false (desktop/src/app/(app)/layout.tsx).
Settings > Security page with change password (and placeholders for 2FA added by R209).
tests: backend/test/first-login.test.ts: provisioned admin (R104 path) logs in with mustChangePassword true; GET /leads -> 403 PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED; change-password with wrong current -> 401, too short -> 400, success -> new token works and old refresh tokens are revoked; outbox has password_changed.

desktop/e2e/first-login.spec.ts (multi slot): create an agency through the backend admin API (helper with a super admin token created via the test route or SQL), read the temporary password from GET /test/outbox, log in, land on /change-password, set a new one, land on /onboarding, upload a logo, finish, dashboard shows company name.
acceptance: A first login cannot reach any data until the password is changed (tests).

cd desktop && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit
cd desktop && npx vitest run   # pass: 0 failing files, passed >= last merged count (1294 on 2026-10-14)
cd desktop && E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3110 E2E_API_URL=http://localhost:8797/api/v1 npx playwright test e2e/first-login.spec.ts e2e/auth-shell.spec.ts e2e/settings-company.spec.ts
notes: Before editing read: this batch file, docs/readiness/READINESS-PLAN.md sections 0 and the design note for this area, desktop/audit/fix/FIX-PLAN.md sections 3-4 (executor rules, worktree bootstrap with node_modules junctions; never npm install inside a worktree unless the batch adds a dependency, and then only in the main checkout by the orchestrator).

Backend tests follow the existing pattern (see backend/test/voip-callbacks.test.ts): import env, createExecutionContext, waitOnExecutionContext, applyD1Migrations from cloudflare:test; applyD1Migrations(env.MASTER_DB, env.TEST_MIGRATIONS) in beforeAll; POST /api/v1/test/reset; call worker.fetch(request, env, ctx). isolatedStorage is false and singleWorker true, so use unique ids/emails per test file.

Desktop UI follows desktop/audit/remake/CONTRACT.md: ds-* indigo tokens only (no raw palette classes or hex), archetypes (ListPage/EntityForm/DetailPage or PageContainer + PageHeader), FilterBar + useInfiniteScroll for lists, RelationCombobox for relations, PhoneInput for phones, useConfirm instead of window.confirm, graceful degradation when an env key is missing. lint-gate must not rise for any file you touch.
The seeded demo admin has must_change_password 0, so existing e2e specs are unaffected.
Creating a super admin for e2e: add a TEST_MODE-only POST /test/super-admin in routes/test.ts if no simpler path exists (allowed edit: backend/src/routes/test.ts; note it).
